title: Short-Sale Statement Servicing Fee
content:
Servicing fee on a short-sale statement — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

**Clause.** On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale statement servicing fee enters the short-sale statement balance. For a HECM whose servicing fee option, as recorded under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product, is a monthly fee with set-aside, it is the monthly-adjustable servicing fee of its payout plan when its rate type is monthly adjustable, or the annual-or-fixed servicing fee of its payout plan when its rate type is annual adjustable or fixed, for each short-sale fee month still to post; a HECM whose servicing fee is included in the rate, and a Summit loan, carry nothing (0.00).

**Short-sale fee months still to post.** The whole calendar months from the first day of the latest accrual period among the posted HECM servicing fee entries on the loan to the statement date; a loan with no posted servicing fee counts 0 months.

**Basis questions.**

*Which monthly figure is used?* The payout plan's monthly-adjustable fee for a monthly-adjustable HECM; its annual-or-fixed fee for an annual-adjustable or fixed-rate HECM.

*Does a fee included in the rate add anything?* No.

*Hypothetical:* a fixed-rate HECM with a monthly fee option, a payout plan fee taken as USD 35.00 for the illustration, latest posted fee for the January accrual period and a statement dated 1 March counts 2 fee months: USD 70.00.
